name: Import messy contacts without inventing missing values
property_tested: Tolerant parsing; strict output types and missing-value semantics

turns.prompt: Import {WORKSPACE}/contacts.csv for our address-book app. Save contacts.json as an array with only id, name, phone, and email for each row. Trim surrounding whitespace, keep phone numbers as text, and use null for a missing email. The notes column is for internal use and isn't part of this import.

pre_turn_perturbations.content:
id,name,phone,email,notes
 C1 , Ada Kim , 00123 , ada@example.test , VIP
C2, Bo Ray ,00456, , call later

complexity.notes: Authored depth estimates count dependent reasoning/action stages, not tool calls. Fault count counts adverse episodes, including supplied bad data and context loss; fixtures and user revisions alone are excluded. Input files count distinct fixture paths. Record count is the number of initial CSV data rows, excluding the header.
